item.title: Moving from GitHub to Codeberg, for lazy people
item.description:
📝 Moving from GitHub to Codeberg, for lazy people 2025-09-06 I’ve just started to migrate some repositories from GitHub to Codeberg. If you’re using GitHub Pages you can use codeberg. If you absolutely need macOS runners I’d recommend sticking with GitHub Actions on the GitHub repository, mirroring all commits from Codeberg to GitHub and using Forgejo Actions to poll the GitHub API and sync the CI status back to Codeberg.
🔗 Read more: https://unterwaditzer.net/2025/codeberg.html

item.title: Newly purchased Vizio TVs now require Walmart accounts to use smart features
item.description:
📝 The representative added: Customers who already have an existing Vizio account are being given the option to merge their Vizio account with their Walmart account. Customers with an existing Vizio account can opt out by deleting their Vizio account. Furthering Vizio TVs’ transformation into a Walmart ad vehicle, Walmart announced this week that Vizio OS will show ads for beauty brand L’Oréal that connect to Walmart’s and other companies’ product pages.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/03/newly-purchased-vizio-tvs-now-require-walmart-accounts-to-use-smart-features/

item.title: French e, è, é, ê, ë – what's the difference?
item.description:
📝 This diacritical mark can appear also above other vowels. This happens with many other verbs, eg. It used wherever the pronunciation requires this sound, but the general rules would dictate otherwise if no accent were used.
